release: Infinite Realms v0.7.8.7 — Map and Location Integration
status: Built and validated; accepted v0.7.8.7 baseline prepared for future work.

starting_artifact.qualification: The prior v0.7.8.6 report marked that artifact a candidate with unresolved regression/browser checks; it is preserved as a rollback, not described as a verified accepted baseline.

validation.standalone_smoke_suites: 3/3 passed; 24 explicit checks and 54 embedded script blocks inspected

feature_notes: Political map labels and location details observe discovered-information rules.
Missing ownership is unknown; only explicit unclaimed metadata renders confirmed-unclaimed status.
No boundary polygons exist in the current data model, so political border paths are not inferred.
Five seeded worlds each generated three stable polities and metadata-only regions in the tests.
Legacy worlds without political data receive minimal initialization without repartitioning valid site assignments.
The World map fallback says boundary geometry is unavailable, without claiming no political entities exist.
limitations: The v0.7.8.6 starting artifact was a candidate with unresolved checks in its earlier report.
Political borders are not drawn because supported boundary geometry is absent.
